subject: math
cluster: Solve real-life and mathematical problems involving angle measure, area, surface area, and volume
intro: Each problem uses a single named figure with all dimensions given. Apply one formula: $A=bh$ for rectangles and parallelograms, $A=\frac{1}{2}bh$ for triangles, $V=Bh$ (or $V=lwh$) for prisms. Attach correct units: square units for area, cubic units for volume.

items.prompt: Find the area of a rectangle with length $12\text{ cm}$ and width $5\text{ cm}$.

steps: Use the rectangle area formula $A=bh$, where $b$ is the length and $h$ is the width.
Area uses square units, so $A=60\text{ cm}^2$.

items.prompt: Find the area of a triangle with base $14\text{ cm}$ and height $9\text{ cm}$.
Find the area of a parallelogram with base $8\text{ in}$ and height $6\text{ in}$.

steps: Area uses square units, so $A=48\text{ in}^2$.

items.prompt: Find the area of a triangle with base $10\text{ m}$ and height $4\text{ m}$.
Find the area of a square with side length $7\text{ ft}$.

steps: A square is a rectangle whose length and width are equal, so $A=bh$ with $b=h=7$.
Area uses square units, so $A=49\text{ ft}^2$.

items.prompt: Find the volume of a rectangular prism that is $6\text{ cm}$ long, $4\text{ cm}$ wide, and $3\text{ cm}$ tall.

steps: Use the rectangular prism volume formula $V=lwh$.
Volume uses cubic units, so $V=72\text{ cm}^3$.

items.prompt: Find the volume of a cube with edge length $5\text{ cm}$.

steps: A cube has equal edges, so $V=lwh$ with $l=w=h=5$.
Volume uses cubic units, so $V=125\text{ cm}^3$.

steps: Area uses square units, so $A=60\text{ mm}^2$.
